svg.title: Gatehall of Shells — Double shell arch
svg.desc: Two shell arches frame a quiet return door. A guard balcony and sluice inspection gantry branch toward the barracks and cistern; the ceremonial road continues to Pearl Hall. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
